shared_elements: schematic boat in profile with upturned/hooked prow and stern
row of short vertical strokes along the hull representing crew
multiple boats of varying size scattered across the rock surface
animal figure with horns/antlers (A) vs quadruped figures (B)
justification: Both surfaces show the same highly distinctive scheme: profile boats with hooked, up-curled prow and stern lines whose hulls carry a comb-like row of short vertical crew strokes, one large boat dominating with smaller boats, tiny stick-figure humans and isolated dots scattered loosely across an open rock panel with no ground line or frame. The main differences are A's prominent horned/antlered animal and its pair of armed figures with staffs, versus B's denser cluster of many small boats and a hull with an internal grid of hull planking lines; these are variations within what looks like one iconographic tradition.
